label: Goal-relative force with indifference excludes preference-independent reasons (inference)
rule: Universal instantiation at the indifferent preference
meaning: Conditional analyst argument, attribution deferred: if force at a preference requires the accuracy aim and some supplied preference lacks it, no reason has force at every supplied preference. Combined with the answerability argument, the actual-force concession, answerability, the goal-relative account and an indifference alternative cannot all hold in one frame.
